_styles.cartoon: Whimsical flat cartoon illustration, bright cheerful colors, clean bold outlines, modern children's picture-book style, ancient Israel. Scene:
_styles.cinematic: Photorealistic still frame from an epic big-budget historical film set in ancient Israel, dramatic golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, anamorphic 35mm look, rich color grade. Scene:
_styles.snapshot: Candid amateur 1990s disposable-camera snapshot, harsh on-camera flash, slight motion blur, oversaturated colors, awkward tilted framing, as if a tourist stumbled into ancient Israel. Scene:

_suffix: Everyone modestly dressed: long sleeves, long skirts, high necklines. Show men and boys; include women only when the scene cannot work without them. Jewish setting in ancient Israel. No text, letters or writing anywhere.
_kg: a Jewish high priest in plain white linen robes, white sash and white turban
melech: a surprised man wrapped in a white prayer shawl at a wooden synagogue lectern, behind him a giant board-game path where his game piece is sliding all the way back to the starting square
dirshu: a grand palace at night with its huge doors wide open and warm golden light pouring out, small people happily walking in, ten lanterns hanging along the path
apology: a family dinner table: a bearded man sits with arms crossed, turning his face away; beside him his wife, in a long dress with her hair fully covered by a headscarf, gives him a pointed side-eye; in the open doorway his brother-in-law holds a bunch of flowers, and behind him stand three solemn bearded men in long robes lined up formally like witnesses in a court, one of them holding a small wax writing tablet and stylus, all watching intently
calf: a bearded ancient leader in simple robes on a mountaintop raising his arms and pleading toward dramatic sunlit clouds, far below in the valley a tiny golden calf statue and a crowd
kgama: {kg} sitting behind a stone table with a microphone like a press conference, torches on the walls, curious people raising hands
snap: night in a stone temple courtyard: {kg} yawning with eyes half closed while two energetic young priests in white snap their fingers right next to his face
roast: a festive street procession in ancient Jerusalem: the whole crowd has turned its back on a pompous Jewish high priest (blue robe with a hem of little golden bells, jeweled breastplate with twelve colored stones, tall wound white cloth turban with a gold band on the forehead) and is happily following two humble smiling elderly bearded rabbis in plain robes; the high priest stands alone, arms crossed, offended
happy: a joyful circle of young women with long braided hair, clearly feminine faces, in long-sleeved, ankle-length, high-necked flowing white dresses, dancing hand in hand in a lush green vineyard at golden hour, arms fully covered to the wrist
thread: the huge ornate golden doors of the Second Temple sanctuary in Jerusalem at dusk, a long strip of deep scarlet wool tied to the door handle, still completely red; a crowd of worried bearded men in long robes and a few kohanim in white linen stand in front of it staring at the red strip in dismay, some with hands on their heads; flat-topped stone Temple architecture. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
yonah: on a dusty hilltop east of a huge mud-brick Assyrian walled city, a bearded Jewish prophet in a long robe and head wrap lounges contentedly in the deep green shade of a giant leafy gourd vine that arches over him like a beach cabana, arms folded behind his head, a clay cup at his side, staring expectantly at the city like someone waiting for a fireworks show to start; the city is completely intact and peaceful, its people and even the cattle wearing rough sackcloth; a fat green worm is visibly chewing through the base of the vine stem right next to him, and he has not noticed; blazing sun everywhere outside the shade
rain: a family sitting at a table inside a sukkah hut with a palm-branch roof while heavy rain pours through, soup bowls overflowing with rainwater, everyone dismayed
kick: a man in ancient robes angrily kicking a small wooden hut with a leafy roof on a flat rooftop under an enormous blazing sun
torches: an elderly bearded sage in robes joyfully juggling eight flaming torches at night in a temple courtyard lit by giant golden lamps, crowd cheering, musicians with harps on wide stone steps
clouds: a long line of ancient Israelite families with donkeys walking through the desert, completely surrounded by a giant ring of soft glowing white clouds wrapping around them like a protective blanket
bulls: a long parade of many bulls walking in a line toward the Second Temple of Jerusalem on a hill, a massive flat-topped white-and-gold stone facade with tall columns, surrounded by stone walls
minim: inside a crowded wood-paneled synagogue on the festival of Sukkot: an eight-year-old boy with long curly sidelocks and a small black kippah, white shirt, standing on a wooden bench with one arm stretched out stiffly, aiming a tall green palm frond bundle (with myrtle and willow tied on) at a small black internet router with blinking green lights mounted high on the stone wall, a yellow citron held up in his other hand like a phone, squinting hard in concentration, as if hunting for a signal; behind him a row of bearded men in white prayer shawls all aim their own palm fronds at the same router in unison, and a stern old gabbai with a long white beard glares at the boy over his glasses. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
atzeres: a kind bearded king in a warm candlelit banquet hall hugging his children at the door as they get ready to leave, the table still set
tablets: a bearded ancient leader on a rocky mountain slope hurling two large blank stone tablets that shatter on the ground, below a crowd dancing around a small golden calf
achnai: inside an ancient study hall, bearded rabbis calmly debating at a table while outside the window a whole carob tree flies through the air and a stream flows uphill
akiva: an old bearded man in ancient robes sitting in the back row of a crowded ancient Jewish study hall with plain stone walls and shelves of scrolls, scratching his head in confusion while a teacher lectures enthusiastically at the front
lev: an open parchment scroll on two wooden rollers being rewound from the end to the beginning, a glowing red heart between the rollers, people dancing in a circle around it
c_beam: a triumphant ancient king in royal robes standing amid the smoking rubble of his own palace, which is torn half down: collapsed walls, a gaping hole in the roof, fallen columns, piles of broken stone; he holds a single wooden beam proudly over his head, huge grin
c_cow: a solemn cow wearing a rough burlap sack as clothing, standing next to an empty feeding trough, looking hungry but determined
c_sailors: ancient sailors on a wooden ship in a huge storm rowing desperately toward a distant shore
c_aharon: a nervous bearded priest very slowly placing one single stone on an unfinished stone altar while glancing at a sundial
c_ark: inside an open golden chest, two whole smooth blank grey stone tablets with rounded tops standing upright next to a neat pile of broken pieces of the same blank tablets, soft light
c_floor: {kg} standing barefoot on a cold marble floor at night, shivering, eyes wide open
pending: inside a grand ancient stone hall of judgment, three enormous open ledger books on tall wooden stands; smiling men in robes walk away happily holding scrolls sealed with red wax, while one anxious bearded man in a simple robe and head covering stands at a wooden counter pressing a brass service bell again and again, staring at a large hourglass that is only half run out, a long queue of people behind him
wall: a narrow old-city alley: a hurried young Jewish man with a kippah takes a shortcut, squeezing sideways right under a tall cut-stone wall that leans dramatically out over the alley at a scary angle, a crack running up it, dust and pebbles trickling down; a single bright spotlight beam shines down from a gap in the clouds straight onto him alone, like a stage spotlight picking him out of the crowd, and he freezes and looks up at it nervously; bearded men in long robes at both ends of the alley stop and point
lovelevel: at an ancient money-changer's wooden table in a sunny stone marketplace, a burly muscular former gladiator with a scarred face, now dressed as a humble scholar in a simple long robe and head covering, slides a small pile of dull black pebbles across the table, and the smiling old money-changer slides back a much bigger pile of shining gold coins; male onlookers in head wraps gasp
kimchis: an ancient Jerusalem market street: {kg} stands frozen in horror, holding out his sleeve and staring at one tiny wet droplet on the white linen; a chatty merchant in a long robe, seen from behind, is mid-sentence with his hands raised; in the background at the temple gate, the priest's younger brother cheerfully puts on an identical white turban and gives a thumbs up
fasting: a modern Jewish family kitchen on the morning of Yom Kippur, everyone dressed in white: a determined nine-year-old boy with a kippah and sidelocks sits at the table with arms crossed, staring hard at an hourglass on the table, while his smiling mother in a long-sleeved dress and a headscarf covering all of her hair holds a plate with a small breakfast just out of his reach, waiting for the sand to run out
mikvah: dawn over an old stone Jerusalem neighborhood: an all-male line of bearded Jewish men and teenage boys in white shirts and kippot, towels over their shoulders, waiting outside a small stone bathhouse, and soft sparkling rain falls from glowing golden clouds onto the whole town, so every man in the line is already being gently sprinkled, looking up in surprise and smiling
shammai: cutaway view of an ancient two-story stone house: on the flat roof a stern elderly bearded sage in robes with a hammer and chisel chips away white plaster from between the wooden beams and lays green palm branches over the opening; directly below, inside the room, a newborn baby sleeps in a wooden cradle right under the leafy opening, and the baby's young bearded father, holding a cup of tea, stares up at the ceiling in disbelief as plaster dust drifts down. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
choranit: a small hut with a palm-branch roof built right against the doorway of an ancient stone house: a bearded sage sits with his head and body inside the hut but leans far back through the house door, stretching one arm to reach a dinner table set inside the house; at the hut entrance two groups of elderly bearded rabbis in robes watch him, one group frowning with arms crossed, the other group calm and shrugging
esrogim: the stone ramp of the great altar in the Second Temple courtyard: a priest in white linen robes smugly pours water from a golden jug onto his own sandaled feet, while a huge festive crowd below, each person holding a palm frond bundle, throws yellow citron fruits at him; dozens of yellow citrons fly through the air toward him and he raises an arm to shield himself
luach: a modern Jewish family's leafy sukkah hut on a Shabbat afternoon, white tablecloth, silver candlesticks: a young boy with a kippah stares longingly at a palm-frond lulav bundle and a ram's horn shofar lying on a high shelf behind a red velvet rope like a museum display, while his father, eyes closed, happily sniffs a yellow citron fruit
kids: inside a crowded modern synagogue on Simchat Torah: dozens of little boys with kippot and sidelocks packed tightly onto a small raised wooden reading platform around an open Torah scroll, squeezed shoulder to shoulder, while their fathers in white prayer shawls stand around the platform holding their hands up over the children in blessing, and an old gabbai with a white beard is squeezed at the very edge, holding on
shlomo: a giant joyful banquet in the courtyard of the First Temple in Jerusalem, a gleaming white-and-gold stone temple facade with two tall bronze pillars, long tables piled with food, crowds of bearded men feasting and dancing in circles with arms on each other's shoulders; in the corner three men with worried faces glance nervously at a stone sundial while still holding their food
bookends: two acts of kindness side by side on an old Jerusalem stone street: on the left, bearded men at a free clothing stall wrap a warm wool coat around the shoulders of a shivering poor old man; on the right, a respectful procession of men in dark robes carries a simple covered wooden bier toward the hills, heads bowed; soft warm morning light. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_moving: a smiling ancient family in long robes leading a donkey cart piled high with belongings along a road out of town toward green hills, waving goodbye, the wife in a long dress with a headscarf covering all of her hair
c_wall: a very old stone wall of an ancient study hall leaning forward at a steep angle, like it is bowing politely, over a doorway, while scholars in robes walk underneath carefully and look up nervously
c_receipt: the men's section of an old stone synagogue, only bearded men in white prayer shawls on the benches: a young man in a prayer shawl sits after praying with arms folded, tapping his foot and staring expectantly at the ceiling like a customer waiting for an order at a counter, an hourglass on the bench beside him
c_lips: a large brown bull standing in line at the gate of an ancient stone temple, looking offended, while beside it a man in a white robe with no animal stands with his eyes closed, praying; a priest at the gate waves the praying man in first
c_kimchis: a proud elderly Jewish mother in an ancient stone home, wearing a long modest dress with long sleeves and a large headscarf covering all of her hair, beaming and clasping her hands, standing in front of her seven grown bearded sons of different heights lined up in a row, all wearing identical plain white linen priestly robes and white turbans
c_blessing: a modern Jewish father in a white robe and prayer shawl, eyes full of tears, resting both hands on the head of his young son in a white shirt and kippah, blessing him by the front door of their home in the late afternoon; the mother in a long-sleeved dress and a headscarf covering all of her hair stands beside them with a daughter in a long dress, candles glowing on a table behind
c_line: a very long queue of sleepy Jewish men with kippot and towels over their shoulders stretching out the door of a small stone building and around the corner at early dawn, one man yawning widely, one holding a thermos
c_roof: close-up of an ancient flat roof: bare wooden beams exposed, chunks of white plaster piled neatly to one side, fresh green palm branches laid across the beams; an elderly man's sandaled feet and a long wooden builder's measuring rod beside them
c_helene: an extremely tall hut with a leafy palm-branch roof towering several stories high above a courtyard in an ancient town, a dignified queen in a long embroidered modest gown and a veil covering all of her hair under a small crown standing proudly at the door, next to her seven boys lined up by height like a staircase, from a teenager down to a small child, while elderly bearded rabbis walk in and out of the hut
c_table: a quiet empty stone house: a steaming potato kugel in a baking dish on a dry dinner table set for one, and through the open doorway heavy rain pours onto a small leafy-roofed hut outside
c_raise: a stern Temple official in robes pointing upward and shouting at a young priest in white on a stone altar, and the priest nervously holds a golden jug high above his head with his arm fully stretched up, pouring water down into a silver basin
c_smell: close-up of a bearded man in a white shirt holding a bright yellow citron fruit up to his nose, eyes closed in bliss, inside a leafy sukkah hut, while behind him a palm frond bundle lies untouched on a shelf
c_friday: a chaotic modern kitchen on a Friday afternoon: pots boiling on every burner, a bundle of beaten willow branches lying on the counter next to braided challah loaves, a father in a white shirt and kippah stirring a pot, a mother in a long-sleeved dress and a headscarf covering all of her hair checking the oven
c_menashe: an elderly bearded patriarch in ancient robes sitting up on a bed with two boys standing in front of him: his arms are visibly CROSSED at the forearms in a big X, so his right hand reaches over to rest on the head of the boy on his LEFT side, and his left hand reaches over to rest on the head of the boy on his RIGHT side; their father in fine Egyptian-style robes stands beside the bed, reaching out to uncross the old man's hands, surprised
c_chasan: a proud seven-year-old boy with a kippah standing on a stool at a synagogue reading table next to an open Torah scroll, his father's white prayer shawl draped over his small shoulders, grinning widely, a crowd of men cheering behind him
c_twoparties: two separate festive banquet pavilions side by side in ancient Jerusalem, one decorated with gold temple vessels, the other with leafy palm-branch roofs, and a wise young king in royal robes standing between them, firmly holding the two pavilion doors apart with outstretched arms
c_grave: a rocky desert mountain slope: Roman soldiers in armor split into two groups, the group on the mountaintop points down the slope, the group at the bottom points up the slope, both groups looking confused and arguing
c_scale: a nervous bearded Jewish man in a white shirt and black kippah standing on one pan of a giant antique brass balance scale in an old stone synagogue at dawn; the other pan holds an equally heavy pile of old books; the scale beam is perfectly level, and he checks a pocket watch while waiting. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_splash: a dignified elderly bearded rabbi in ancient robes and a wound turban sitting patiently on the stone doorstep of an ancient house, while from the small upper window above him a tipped wooden bucket pours a stream of grey dirty wash water right onto his head; he keeps his eyes closed and his dignity; only the bucket is visible in the window. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_dinner: {kg} sitting alone at the head of a long wooden table in a stone temple chamber at dusk, staring sadly at one tiny plate holding a single small piece of bread, while stern elderly bearded rabbis stand around the table with folded arms, and a basket of eggs, a yellow citron fruit and a wine jug are being carried out of the room by a young priest. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_axe: a cheerful group of bearded ancient Jewish woodcutters in robes in a sunny late-summer forest, celebrating with their arms raised, one proudly holding up an axe with a snapped handle, stacks of cut logs behind them and the trees around them seem to be standing tall and relieved. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_relay: a long line of wooden lookout platforms stretching across the rocky Judean desert hills into the distance, a bearded man in a robe standing on each platform waving a large white cloth over his head to signal the next one, the nearest man shouting excitedly, a distant goat on a far cliff at the horizon. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_restart: the men's section of a modern synagogue: a flustered yeshiva student in a white shirt and black hat standing alone at his lectern, flipping his prayer book back to the very first pages with a pained face, while all around him the other men have already finished praying and are folding their prayer shawls, and a gabbai beside him shrugs sympathetically. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_skylight: a flat roof of an ancient stone study hall at dawn on a snowy winter day: a poor young man in a thin robe lies flat on his stomach at the edge of an open skylight, almost completely buried under a thick layer of snow, only his face and ear visible as he listens eagerly through the opening; two elderly bearded sages climb a ladder onto the roof, looking alarmed. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_calfout: a desert camp at night: a nervous bearded man in a white priestly robe and turban stands beside a large clay furnace, shrugging with both palms up and an innocent face, as a small shiny golden calf statue walks out of the furnace opening on its own; behind him a tall stern bearded man holding two stone tablets stares at him. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_benchwife: an empty stone temple courtyard in bright daylight with only bearded men in it: on a long wooden sideline bench, like substitutes waiting at a sports match, sit a spare {kg} stretching his arms as if warming up, and next to him a middle-aged Jewish matron in a dark green long-sleeved long dress with a patterned cloth tichel headscarf tied tightly to cover all of her hair, holding a small travel bundle on her lap and checking an hourglass beside her; in the background a few elderly bearded rabbis in robes confer while holding wax tablets. She is the only woman in the picture; everyone else is a bearded man.
c_cantrun: a stormy sea: a bearded ancient prophet in robes rows a tiny wooden boat as fast as he can, looking back over his shoulder in alarm, while an enormous whale calmly swims right behind the boat, keeping pace with a patient expression. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_kugel: close-up inside a modern backyard sukkah hut during a heavy downpour: rain pours through the leafy branch roof onto a wooden table, where a glass baking dish of golden potato kugel is completely flooded, chunks of kugel floating in rainwater like soup; a bearded man in a dripping black hat and white shirt holds a spoon over it with a resigned, defeated face. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_delicate: inside an ancient Babylonian sukkah hut of reeds and palm fronds on a windy day: an elderly bearded rabbi in robes and a wound white turban (plain ears, no earrings or jewelry) sits at a low table and holds up one tiny twig between two fingers with a delicate, offended expression, as little bits of leaves and twigs blow down from the roof into his bowl of food; beside him a younger bearded student in robes gestures at the bowl as if to say it is perfectly fine. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_menu: a long wooden table in an ancient stone house with five dinner plates in a row, left to right each one plainer than the last: a whole roast fattened bird, a grilled fish, a piece of meat, a small bowl of beans, and finally a plate of plain green vegetables; at the far end sits a bearded guest in robes looking down at the vegetable plate with mild concern, while his smiling bearded host stands beside him with open hands. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_fold: flat ancient rooftops of a sprawling city under a huge blazing white-hot sun, heat haze in the air: on several roofs, sweating men in assorted ancient foreign dress (Roman togas, Persian robes and tall caps) angrily kick their flimsy leafy huts, which are toppling over; in the foreground, on his own roof, a calm bearded Jewish man in modest robes quietly walks out of his intact leafy sukkah hut carrying a neatly folded wooden chair, not looking back. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_kidah: Night in a vast stone temple courtyard lit by giant golden oil lamps on tall poles: an elderly bearded sage in white robes, feet planted flat and legs straight, is folded all the way forward at the hips like a jackknife, his two thumbs pressed into the stone floor just in front of his toes and his lips kissing the floor between them, a strained look on his face; eight burning torches lie on the ground beside him; a crowd of bearded men and young Levites with harps stare in amazement, one dropping his torch. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_limp: outside an ancient stone study hall: a bearded rabbi in robes limps out, leaning on a wooden crutch with one hand pressed to his hip and a pained but sheepish face, while an elderly dignified sage in white robes, seated on a carved chair in the doorway, watches with one raised eyebrow, and a few young students behind him try hard not to laugh. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_ship: an ancient wooden sailing ship on a choppy windy sea: a small hut of branches and palm fronds is being blown clean off the deck into the air, fronds flying; a bearded sage in simple robes reaches after it with a sheepish look, while beside him an elderly dignified sage in fine robes and a wound turban stands with arms folded and one eyebrow raised, and two sailors hold on to the rigging. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_velvet: a flawless bright yellow citron fruit (esrog) resting like a precious jewel in an open wooden box lined with deep blue velvet and soft flax fibers, with a silver clasp, lit dramatically like a luxury watch advertisement on a synagogue table; a bearded man in a black hat and a young boy with a kippah lean in close, holding their breath, the man peering through a small magnifying glass. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_unpack: evening in an ancient Jerusalem street of pale stone houses: a bearded pilgrim father in robes, smiling warmly, is untying huge bundles from a hugely overloaded donkey that he had just finished packing for the trip home (rolled blankets, clay pots, baskets, bundles of palm branches), while his young sons happily carry the bundles back inside through the doorway; the donkey looks relieved. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_tears: night inside a simple ancient tent lit by one oil lamp: a very old white-bearded leader in plain robes sits writing the final column of a long parchment scroll with a reed pen, tears running down his cheeks and dripping onto the parchment, while his loyal younger attendant stands quietly in the tent doorway, watching with a heavy heart. The parchment shows only blank columns. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_drip: beside an ancient stone well in the hills of Judea: a forty-year-old bearded shepherd in a rough wool cloak, his staff and a few sheep beside him, crouches and stares in wide-eyed realization at a thick stone slab under a dripping rope bucket, where the steady drips of water have worn a deep round hole clean through the stone; a single drop is falling mid-air. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_scold: inside a simple ancient stone study hall in Roman-era Judea, with no desks and no hats: bearded rabbis in plain ancient robes and wound cloth head-wraps sit on low stone benches and mats along the walls; the two long side walls are leaning steeply inward over their heads, frozen halfway through falling, stones hanging at impossible angles; one elderly rabbi stands up with a raised finger, sternly scolding the leaning wall as if it were a misbehaving student, while an old rabbi on the other side sits calmly with folded arms, and the rest look up nervously. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_wave: an ancient wooden sailing ship on a grey sea: one gigantic wave stands tall over the ship like a wall of water, paused mid-air; on the deck an elderly dignified sage in fine robes and a wound turban stands upright, one hand on his chest, looking up at the wave and speaking earnestly, while two wide-eyed sailors hold on to the mast. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
c_chips: alone on a bare rocky mountain top in the desert at dawn, nobody else anywhere on the mountain: an old bearded leader in plain robes is carving two blank stone tablets with rounded tops out of a block of glowing deep-blue sapphire, hammer and chisel in hand; at his feet lies a big pile of sparkling blue sapphire chips, and he pauses to glance at the pile with a small surprised smile while scooping a handful into a leather pouch. He is the only person in the picture; no women or girls anywhere. Every person in the picture is a man or a boy; no women or girls anywhere.
